## Personality

Odette Pullen is characterized as an unassuming, hardworking, and dutiful individual who earned top marks in domestic science. Known for being steady, sensible, and pragmatic, she maintains an unshakeable composure that others envy. She is also regarded as nice, lady-like, and well-liked by those in [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge). Driven by a commitment to dedicate her entire existence to pedagogy, she intends to refuse marriage forever, even though she finds teaching to be tedious.

## History

Odette Pullen was once a student who wept heavily during the departure of her schoolmaster, Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md), despite having insisted for weeks that she would not shed a tear. During her youth, she played Guinevere in a local play based on Tennyson's [Elaine](../character/elaine.md) and experienced a near-drowning incident when her father caught her sash as she reached for water lilies on the [Lake of Glassy Waters](../codex/places.md#lake-of-glassy-waters). She also frequently visited the local [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and attended social events, such as taking a carriage ride with [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) to perform at a hotel charity concert. She pursued a career in education and secured a position teaching in [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge), where she earned a spot on the Inspector's Roll of Honor and became well-liked by the local community. Prior to starting her teaching term, she engaged in discussions with her peers regarding classroom discipline. Active in her social circle, Odette enjoyed outdoor excursions with friends like [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), exploring local woods and hidden gardens. As a member of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), she joined a delegation alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde to confront [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) over his plans to rent farm fences for commercial advertisements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. The Hotel Concert P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), +24 more_

## Quotes

> "yet I am certain I would be unable to remain motionless. Every minute or two, I would be sitting up to check my position and ensure I was not floating away too much. And Nell, you are aware that such actions would ruin the impression."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002)

> "Would it not be lovely if a person could have three wishes fulfilled . . . or perhaps just one? What wish would you make, girls, if a wish were granted to you? My wish would be for wealth, beauty, and intelligence."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P32](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0032)

> "The main thing will be to keep order and a teacher has to be a little cross to do that. If my pupils won’t do as I tell them I shall punish them."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 IV Different Opinions P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)

> "I’ll give my pupils a whipping whenever they misbehave. That is the most direct and simple method to persuade them."
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 IV Different Opinions P14](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0014)

> "I assume you will not discipline the girls by forcing them to sit beside the boys?"
>
> — Odette Pullen — [v2 IV Different Opinions P23](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0023)

### [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barney-pullen--odette-pullen.md)

[Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) is Odette's brother. He arrives with Odette to escort [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) to a charity concert at the [Pale Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel), and he waits outside to take them home after the event ends.
